title: Utilize irrigation equipment and operate manual sprinkler systems

lessons.title: Know your irrigation equipment
lessons.html:
Why we irrigate

In most parts of South Africa rain does not come when plants need it. Nurseries, parks, sports fields and gardens must be watered by hand or with irrigation. Your job is to give plants the right amount of water, in the right place, at the right time, without wasting it.

Parts of a simple irrigation system

  • Water source – a municipal tap, borehole, dam or JoJo tank.
  • Pump – pushes water through the pipes when there is not enough pressure.
  • Filter – catches sand and dirt so nozzles do not block.
  • Valves and taps – open and close water to each zone (block).
  • Main line and lateral pipes – usually PVC or polyethylene (black poly pipe).
  • Hoses and fittings – couplings, elbows, tees, end caps and clamps.
  • Sprinklers – spray, rotary (impact) or pop-up heads that throw water over an area.

Types of manual sprinklers

TypeHow it worksGood for
Static spray headFixed fan of water, short throwSmall beds and lawns
Impact sprinklerArm hits the stream and turns the headLarge lawns, sports fields
Oscillating sprinklerBar moves side to sideSquare or rectangular lawns
Hose-end sprinkler on a standMoved by hand from place to placeSpot watering

Caring for equipment

Check hoses for cracks and leaks before use. Do not drive a bakkie or mower over hoses. Roll hoses up after work and keep them out of the hot sun. Clean filters regularly. Report broken parts to your supervisor and do not use them until they are fixed. A leaking fitting wastes water and makes muddy, slippery ground.

lessons.title: Operating a manual sprinkler system
lessons.html:
Before you start

  1. Get your instructions: which area, how long, and at what time.
  2. Look at the soil. Push your finger or a trowel into the soil. If it is still wet 5 cm down, it may not need water yet. Ask your supervisor.
  3. Check the weather. Do not water in strong wind (water blows away) or during rain.
  4. Check that hoses, couplings and sprinklers are in good condition.

Setting up

  1. Lay the hose out straight, with no kinks.
  2. Connect the sprinkler firmly. Couplings must click in.
  3. Place the sprinkler so the spray covers the plants, not paths, walls or roads.
  4. Overlap the spray circles a little (head to head) so there are no dry patches.
  5. Open the tap slowly. Opening fast can burst pipes (water hammer).

While watering

  • Watch the spray. Adjust the arc and throw so water lands where it should.
  • Look for run-off. If water runs off the surface, close the tap and water again later in shorter cycles.
  • Time each position. Write down the start and stop time.
  • Water early in the morning or late afternoon. Less water is lost to heat and wind.

Moving and finishing

Close the tap before you move a sprinkler. Move it to the next position and repeat. When finished, close all valves, drain and roll up hoses, and store sprinklers in the store room. Report any leaks, blocked nozzles or dry spots.

Safety

  • Never point a sprinkler at electrical boxes, pumps or cables.
  • Keep hoses off walkways so people do not trip.
  • Do not drink irrigation water from dams or boreholes unless it is marked safe.

Key points

  • Check soil moisture and weather before watering.
  • Inspect hoses, fittings and sprinklers before use.
  • Overlap spray patterns so there are no dry patches.
  • Open taps slowly and close them before moving a sprinkler.
  • Water early or late in the day and avoid run-off.

quiz.question: What is the job of a filter in an irrigation system?

options.text: To catch sand and dirt so nozzles do not block
To measure how much water is used

quiz.question: When is the best time of day to water with sprinklers?

options.text: At midday when it is hottest

quiz.question: Why should you open the tap slowly?

options.text: Opening fast can burst pipes (water hammer)
It makes the sprinkler throw further

quiz.question: What should you do if water starts running off the surface?

options.text: Move the sprinkler onto the path
Close the tap and water again later in shorter cycles

quiz.question: Which sprinkler type is best for large lawns and sports fields?
You should close the tap before moving a sprinkler to a new position.
It is fine to point a sprinkler at an electrical box as long as it is closed.
